Error414.description: Request URI Too Long: the URL is longer than the server accepts.

Error422.description: Unprocessable Entity: source_too_large, limit_exceeded, unsupported, corrupt, hash_mismatch.

Error429.description: Too Many Requests: overloaded. Retry-After is set when the limiter rejected the request.

Error501.description: Not Implemented: a request kind this build does not implement yet (for example /info without an inspector).

Error503.description: Service Unavailable: unavailable. Retry-After is set when the limiter rejected the request.

kind.description: Error kind (errs.Kind), one per row of the status table. See the status table in the ErrorResponse description.

message.description: Client-safe message; internal error text is never sent.

request_id.description: Request ID, also in the logs.

ErrorResponse.description:
JSON error body, sent when Accept lists application/json (text/plain otherwise). Status per kind (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §12; XI_COMPAT_IMGPROXY_STATUS=true answers 400 and forbidden 403 with 404, like imgproxy):

| kind | status | message |
|---|---|---|
| unknown | 500 | internal server error |
| invalid_url | 400 | invalid url |
| unauthorized | 403 | invalid signature |
| forbidden | 403 | forbidden |
| expired | 404 | url expired |
| not_found | 404 | source image not found |
| source_too_large | 422 | source image too large |
| limit_exceeded | 422 | image exceeds processing limits |
| unsupported | 422 | unsupported image format |
| corrupt | 422 | image cannot be decoded |
| hash_mismatch | 422 | source hash mismatch |
| not_acceptable | 406 | no acceptable image format |
| upstream_error | 502 | upstream error |
| upstream_timeout | 504 | upstream timeout |
| overloaded | 429 | too many requests |
| unavailable | 503 | service unavailable |
| timeout | 504 | processing timeout |
| canceled | 499 | request canceled |
| internal | 500 | internal server error |

499 (canceled) is logged, never written.

info.description: Self-hosted image processing proxy. Image URLs follow URL dialects (imgproxy is the default, see https://github.com/xantiagoma/xtandard-image/blob/main/docs/URL-DIALECTS.md); /info reports source metadata. Operations tagged admin are served only on the admin listener (XI_ADMIN_ADDR), never on the public one. The image and /info operations document a path grammar: the processing options and the source contain "/", so generated HTTP clients are not expected to call them; their x-xi-* extensions are the contract for URL builders.

Each URL is parsed back with its dialect's parser and compared with the canonical request: unsupported lists the fields the dialect cannot express, approximated those it writes with a different value. URLs of mounted dialects are signed like api/sign; the others use the dialect's default prefix. Cross-origin requests are rejected.

get.x-xi-path-grammar:
/%signature/%options.../plain/%source_url[@%extension]
/%signature/%options.../%base64url_source_url[.%extension]      (may be split with "/")
/%signature/%options.../enc/%aes_cbc_source[.%extension]        (may be split with "/")
/info/%signature/%info_options.../{plain/…|%base64…|enc/…}

option      = name ":" arg *(":" arg)        ; separator configurable (XI_DIALECTS_IMGPROXY_ARGUMENTS_SEPARATOR)
pipeline    = option *("/" option)
pipelines   = pipeline *("/-/" pipeline)       ; chained pipelines
bool        = "1" | "t" | "true" | "0" | "f" | "false"

x-xi-signing.description: HMAC-SHA256(key, salt ‖ path after the signature, starting with /), url-safe base64 without padding, optionally truncated to XI_SIGNING_SIZE bytes; any value (conventionally unsafe) when signing is off.
